name: go-documentation
description: > Go documentation conventions: godoc comments, package docs, testable Example functions, deprecation notices, and doc links. Use when: "add godoc", "document this package", "write doc comments", "add examples to docs", "deprecate a function", "package documentation", "improve the docs". Not for: commit messages (git-commit), README-level guides (plain writing task), code style (go-coding-standards).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 用于按 Go 社区规范补全文档注释、包说明、可测试示例、弃用提示和文档链接，适合完善代码级 API 文档。
